name: LAN-Orangutan
description: LAN Orangutan is a lightweight network scanner with persistent device labeling, multi-network support, and Tailscale integration. Built by 291 Group.
readme_summary: LAN Orangutan is a self-hosted network discovery tool for homelab users. It allows users to scan their networks, identify devices, and manage them with persistent labeling and notes through a web dashboard or CLI. It also features integration with Tailscale for managing VPN peers.
key_features: Label, group, and add notes to devices
Modern web dashboard with light/dark mode
primary_use_case: Network discovery and device management for homelab environments.
cover_image_prompt: A friendly orangutan wearing a hard hat and holding a magnifying glass, standing in a bustling digital cityscape representing a home network. The orangutan is pointing its magnifying glass at various glowing icons of devices (computers, smart devices, servers) scattered throughout the scene, revealing their labels and connection status. Subtle UI elements like network maps and device lists are visible on small holographic screens floating around the orangutan. The overall mood is helpful and organized, with a clean, modern aesthetic. The style should be a 3D isometric illustration with vibrant colors and clear, friendly character design, emphasizing ease of use and comprehensive network overview.

name: SearchPhone
description: Phone number OSINT toolkit with multi-API search (Google, GitHub, Numverify, Reddit, DuckDuckGo), Hudson Rock infostealer intelligence, and automatic report generation.
readme_summary: SearchPhone is a Python-based OSINT toolkit designed to retrieve information linked to a phone number. It leverages multiple APIs including Google (via SerpAPI), DuckDuckGo, GitHub, Numverify, Reddit, and Hudson Rock to gather data, validate numbers, and check for infostealer compromises. The tool offers parallel processing for speed and generates automatic reports in JSON and PDF formats.
primary_use_case: To perform comprehensive open-source intelligence (OSINT) investigations on a given phone number by aggregating data from various online sources and APIs.
cover_image_prompt: A digital detective, depicted as a wise owl with glowing cybernetic eyes, perches on a network cable. In front of the owl, a single phone number floats, surrounded by streams of data. The owl's talons are sifting through these data streams, pulling out distinct pieces of information: a small GitHub logo, a Reddit icon, a magnifying glass over a map, and a warning symbol. These pieces are neatly organized into a glowing report on a holographic display. The background is a dark, abstract network grid with subtle code snippets. The overall mood is mysterious and analytical. Style: 3D isometric illustration with a clean, modern aesthetic and a cool blue and green color palette.

name: legend
description: Legend builds and publishes Grafana dashboards for your services with prefilled metrics and alerts for your services.
readme_summary: Legend is a tool that automates the creation and publishing of Grafana dashboards for various services and infrastructure components. It pre-fills dashboards with relevant metrics and alerts, reducing manual configuration effort.
key_features: Builds dashboards for services with prefilled metrics
Automatic setup of basic alerts with priority and service mapping
Supports a wide range of components including Airflow, AWS services, Kubernetes, databases, and web servers
Extensible support for components logging to Cloudwatch, InfluxDB, Loki, or Prometheus
primary_use_case: Automating the generation and deployment of Grafana dashboards for monitoring services and infrastructure.
cover_image_prompt: A master craftsman, holding a blueprint labeled 'Legend', is effortlessly assembling intricate, glowing clockwork mechanisms representing various services (like a server rack, a database, a Kubernetes pod). These mechanisms are being placed onto a large, pre-designed Grafana dashboard canvas that materializes around him. Data streams flow from the services into the dashboard, illuminating pre-set alert icons and metric graphs. The scene is a bright, organized workshop with subtle digital particles and UI elements hinting at automation. The style should be a 3D isometric illustration with a clean, modern aesthetic and a vibrant color palette, emphasizing ease of use and comprehensive monitoring.

readme_summary: Legend is a tool that automates the creation and management of Grafana dashboards for services. It pre-populates dashboards with relevant metrics and alerts, reducing manual effort and ensuring uniformity across monitoring setups.

name: nginx-ignition
description: An user interface for the nginx web server, aimed at developers and enthusiasts that don't want to manage configuration files manually
readme_summary: nginx-ignition is a Go-based web UI for managing the Nginx web server, designed to simplify configuration for developers and enthusiasts. It offers an intuitive interface for tasks like virtual host management, stream proxying, SSL certificate handling, and security configurations, aiming to provide powerful control without manual file editing.
key_features: Integrations with Docker, Tailscale, NetBird, TrueNAS
Option to run Nginx or just generate config
primary_use_case: To provide a user-friendly graphical interface for configuring and managing the Nginx web server, abstracting away the complexity of manual configuration file editing for developers and enthusiasts.
cover_image_prompt: A friendly, anthropomorphic Nginx server character, depicted as a skilled conductor, orchestrating a symphony of digital traffic. The conductor holds a glowing baton, directing streams of data (represented by colorful, flowing ribbons) towards various destinations (small, stylized buildings labeled 'Host A', 'Stream B', etc.). In the background, a subtle, clean user interface panel displays simple controls and real-time statistics, like a conductor's score. The overall mood is organized, efficient, and modern, with a touch of playful sophistication. The art style should be a 3D isometric illustration with soft lighting and a vibrant, yet uncluttered color palette, emphasizing ease of control and powerful management.
